threat_event: CUI drawings exfiltrated through a takeover of the shared commercial orders mailbox, which still receives Supplier B drawing packages
threat_source: Cybercriminal or foreign intelligence actor using password spraying
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared mailbox with no MFA and legacy sign-in allowed; Supplier B sends CUI to the commercial suite; no alert on new forwarding rules
existing_controls: MFA on the 5 named commercial suite accounts; firewall
treatment_plan: Redirect Supplier B to SYS-01 email; migrate and purge CUI from SYS-02; MFA on or removal of the shared mailbox; block legacy sign-in; alert on forwarding rules

threat_event: Phishing page steals a CUI suite user's password and MFA approval or session, and the attacker downloads the job folders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: App-based MFA can be phished; no alert on mass download; no security awareness training
existing_controls: MFA on all SYS-01 accounts; provider-side detections
treatment_plan: Annual training with phishing simulations; SYS-01 alerts for mass download and risky sign-ins; phishing-resistant keys for the President and Office Manager

threat_event: CUI copies stored in the MSP's commercial cloud backup, which is not FedRAMP authorized, are exposed or found in a prime or DoD review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly images of SYS-03 and SYS-04 include the synced job folders; no CMMC terms in the MSP contract
existing_controls: Backup sets encrypted and access-controlled by the vendor
treatment_plan: Backup of SYS-01 job folders inside the government-community offering and a settings folder by 2026-09-15; stop the commercial image backup; deletion confirmation by 2026-09-30

threat_event: Prime A or DoD finds that the SPRS score of 110 does not reflect implementation, leading to lost awards and legal exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score posted 2025-12-15 from a yes/no checklist with no SSP or evidence; recalculated score is far lower (P03)
existing_controls: None before this engagement; counsel engaged 2026-07-28
treatment_plan: Post the recalculated score with a date to reach 110 by 2026-09-30; update after each milestone; Affirming Official signs nothing without evidence

threat_event: The company does not hold CMMC Level 2 (Self) status and affirmation by 2027-04-01 and cannot receive new Prime A purchase orders (about 40% of revenue)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 92 of 110 requirements not fully met at fieldwork (score -161); no IT staff; MSP has no CMMC terms
existing_controls: This engagement; approved remediation budget
treatment_plan: Work the P03 roadmap; readiness re-check 2027-01; Level 2 self-assessment and SPRS posting by 2027-03-15; monthly POA&M review with the President

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI cannot be reported to DoD within 72 hours, and evidence is not preserved
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DoD-approved medium assurance certificate; no DIBNet account; no incident plan before 2026-08-31; logs at defaults
existing_controls: Cyber insurance with panel forensics
treatment_plan: Certificates for the President and Office Manager; P08 runbook; printed contact list; tabletop with a DIBNet drill; monthly audit log export

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's shared administrator account or RMM platform gives an attacker control of every computer and both suites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One administrator account shared by 3 technicians; RMM runs commands on every computer; no responsibility matrix or incident notice term
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05
existing_controls: MFA on the shared SYS-01 admin account; MSP SOC 2 Type 2 report
treatment_plan: Named MSP admin accounts with MFA; written responsibility matrix; incident notice within 24 hours and U.S.-person technicians in the contract; monthly review of RMM sessions

threat_event: Ransomware on a laptop spreads across the flat network to the CAM workstation, quality PC, and the networked CNC controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; local admin on SYS-03; SMB file shares on CNC controls; no 24x7 monitoring
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-06; BP-01 to BP-03
existing_controls: Antivirus on all computers; MSP patching; firewall
treatment_plan: Enclave VLAN with deny-by-default rules; remove local admin; managed detection on the 4 computers

threat_event: A foreign-national service engineer or customer visitor sees ITAR drawings on the shop floor, an unauthorized release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visitors not logged or escorted consistently; drawings posted at machines; a foreign-national service engineer worked at a machine with a drawing posted in May 2026
existing_controls: Locked building; President knows the ITAR rules
treatment_plan: Visitor log and escort rule; citizenship question when booking service visits; cover or remove drawings before a foreign person enters; Empowered Official review of the May 2026 visit

threat_event: A server-free shop still cannot recover quickly because the MSP has no recovery commitment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP contract has a 4-business-hour response time and no recovery time; no restore test of SYS-03 or SYS-04
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-07; BP-01 to BP-03
existing_controls: MSP standard image; SYS-01 file versions
treatment_plan: Recovery time terms at contract renewal; restore test of SYS-03 from the new backup and image; short contingency plan

threat_event: Printed drawings or setup sheets thrown in the general trash are recovered by someone outside the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No shredder or shred bin; drawings are reprinted for every job
existing_controls: Building is locked after hours
treatment_plan: Locked shred bin and cross-cut shredder; CUI marking on printed drawings; shift-end drawing return

threat_event: A USB drive used to load the older CNC machines is lost with CUI programs on it, or carries malware into SYS-03
threat_source: Accidental loss; malware on personal or vendor media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 unlabeled drives with no owner at the older machines; personal drives allowed; no encryption
existing_controls: Antivirus scans USB drives on SYS-03
treatment_plan: 2 company-owned encrypted drives in a locked drawer, logged and wiped after use; block other USB storage on SYS-03 and SYS-04

threat_event: A former employee or contractor still has access to company email or the Prime A portal and uses it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offboarding checklist; a part-time programmer kept access for 110 days (disabled 2026-07-15)
existing_controls: Accounts disabled 2026-07-15; logs showed no use after his last day
treatment_plan: Offboarding checklist covering SYS-01, SYS-02, ERP, the Prime A portal, keys, and MFA registrations; monthly account check

threat_event: The President's personal phone, which reads CUI email with no device controls, is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmanaged personal phone with the suite mobile app; no remote wipe
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 data on a mobile device
existing_controls: Phone screen lock (personal setting); SYS-01 MFA
treatment_plan: App-level protection policy with remote wipe of company data, or block mobile access

threat_event: Internet outage stops access to the CUI suite, the ERP, and the Prime A portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One business internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Machines and the CMM run offline; phone hotspot from a laptop
treatment_plan: Accepted by the President: machining continues offline and a phone hotspot covers short outages. Revisit if outages exceed 1 day in a quarter

threat_event: CUI text is pasted into a public generative AI chatbot, outside any authorized system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list or rule before 2026-08-31; public AI reachable from SYS-03
existing_controls: None before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: POL-04 rule on AI tools; web category block for public AI on enclave computers; training; Empowered Official and counsel decision on the June 2026 paste (P10)

threat_event: Shared QC login and local administrator rights let changes or malware go unattributed on the quality PC and CAM workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local login on SYS-04; local admin on SYS-03; no MFA on local sign-in
existing_controls: Antivirus; MSP patching
treatment_plan: Named accounts with suite identity and MFA on both PCs; remove local admin

threat_event: A known vulnerability on a computer or the firewall is exploited because nobody scans for it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning; CAM, DNC, and CMM software updated manually and behind
existing_controls: MSP monthly operating system patching
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans by the MSP; 14-day limit for critical patches; quarterly update check for CAM, DNC, and CMM software

threat_event: The only CNC Programmer is unavailable for weeks and new work stops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person programs all complex parts; procedures are not written
existing_controls: Lead Machinist can program simple parts at the control
treatment_plan: Written programming notes for the 10 highest-volume parts; standby arrangement with a contract programmer who is a U.S. person, screened before CUI access

threat_event: Drawing PDFs attached to ERP job records are exposed in a breach of the ERP vendor
threat_source: Cybercriminal group attacking the ERP vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 job records carry CUI drawing PDFs in a commercial SaaS not authorized for CUI
existing_controls: ERP vendor security (unverified)
treatment_plan: Remove the attachments; rule of drawing numbers only in the ERP; quarterly attachment report

threat_event: An NC or CMM program one revision old is used after a restore or change, producing nonconforming flight parts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No revision check step in recovery; programs live in several places (job folders, SYS-03, controller memory, USB)
existing_controls: First-article inspection on every new revision
treatment_plan: Revision check against the job folder before any restored program is used; written in the contingency plan and P08

threat_event: After an incident the company cannot tell DoD or the prime which CUI was accessed, because logs are short-lived and unreviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default audit retention; firewall logs on the device only; no log review
existing_controls: SYS-01 provider audit logging
treatment_plan: Monthly export of SYS-01 audit logs; firewall logs forwarded by the MSP; monthly review checklist

threat_event: An MSP technician's RMM console login without MFA is taken over and used to reach company computers (found in P07 testing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One of 3 technician logins to the RMM console had no MFA
existing_controls: RMM sessions encrypted; MSP SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: MSP enabled MFA for the technician on 2026-08-12; screenshot evidence and quarterly MSP MFA report

threat_event: A hurricane or long power loss shuts the shop for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida location; no generator; machines need 3-phase power
existing_controls: Property and business interruption insurance; laptops can leave with staff
treatment_plan: Keep property and business interruption insurance; hurricane checklist in the contingency plan (secure printed CUI, power down machines, take laptops)

threat_event: Drawings go to outside processors (anodizing, heat treat) without the DFARS 252.204-7012 flowdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purchase orders to the 2 outside processors use a commercial template
affected_asset_or_process: Printed CUI sent with parts; BP-05
existing_controls: Drawings sent on paper with parts only
treatment_plan: Send only the information the process needs (process sheet without the drawing) where possible; otherwise add the clauses to purchase orders and confirm the processor's SPRS score
